spans.s: ukṣa, m. (false Skt. for Pali, AMg. ukkhā, each recorded once, cf. Pischel 〔194〕, or for Skt. ukhā), pot, vessel: LV 〔324.13〕 (vs) udaro mūtrapurīṣasaṃcayo asucokṣaḥ, the belly is a heap of urine and dung, a vessel of impurities. Is the masc. gender due to assimilation to udara, in this isolated occurrence?
